headline: NEW to scans -- Pezeshkian blames US for interim-deal failure, urges a new attempt
dek: Pezeshkian blamed the United States for the failure of an interim deal with Iran but said there should be a new attempt at concluding it: 'We were having negotiations, the cowards (Americans) messed everything up... I still think we should go and conclude it.' The statement lands while Washington…
sources: Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian, remarks broadcast on state TV, via Reuters
fault_line: Deal or deterrence: is Pezeshkian's 'conclude it' a genuine off-ramp, or a stalling line while the carrier clock runs?

sections.what_happened: Pezeshkian blamed the United States for the failure of an interim deal with Iran but said there should be a new attempt at concluding it: 'We were having negotiations, the cowards (Americans) messed everything up... I still think we should go and conclude it.' The statement lands while Washington masses a third carrier group toward the region (totw-20261024-1900-02) and US strike threats for 'this weekend'/post-midterms circulate — diplomacy offered in the same breath as the threat window. What the 'interim deal' covered, and what the US side says about its failure, is NOT established in the Reuters item: no US response carried.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (T1) carrying the president's own state-TV remarks; Firstpost Instagram carousel (Oct 24, 240 likes/6 comments) reproduces the same quote text but Firstpost has no declared tier in the registry and does NOT count toward corroboration
sections.what_disputed: No US response to the blame claim was found in-window; the interim deal's terms and collapse timeline are not documented in the Reuters item. Counterpoint in substance: the US position (per the wider record) is that strikes remain possible and the carrier buildup continues regardless of talks.
sections.why_matters: The president who says 'conclude it' while the third carrier sails: Tehran offers talks with a deadline attached — the deal window vs the strike window.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (missed in-window catch-up; Reuters Sat Oct 24) -- Pezeshkian blames US for interim-deal failure, urges a new attempt
